# Marks on the page

A note to mark up: every passage below can be chosen, and each is written to be told apart from the rest by its first words.

## The first passage

Alpha passage opens the first section and says one plain thing about the harbour. Beta passage follows it in the same paragraph and says a second thing about the tide. Gamma passage closes the paragraph with a third thing about the lamps.

Delta passage stands in a paragraph of its own, close under the one above it, so that two notes beside them would want the same place in the margin. Epsilon passage ends it.

- Zeta passage is the first item of a list.
- Eta passage is the second item of a list.

## The second passage

Theta passage opens the second section, and it is long enough to wrap across several lines at every width the page is read at, so that a chosen stretch of it can begin on one line and end on another, the way a chosen sentence usually does. Iota passage ends it.

## The third passage

Nu passage opens the third section. Xi passage is a short one. Omicron passage is the last of the note and stands far enough below the rest that its note has room of its own.

### A smaller heading

Pi passage stands under a heading of the third level, which a touch screen is not given buttons for.

Rho passage costs $& and $' each time, which no reader should have to see turned into something else.
